title: IdentifierProduced
description: Producer rule of every normalized name a conforming agent sends as an `Identifier` (ADR-0057 decision 1): the `Identifier` schema of openapi.yaml plus the `not` rules below, applied to the name, to each `.`-separated segment and, in the LDAP container DN form, to each RDN value. A digit is any Unicode decimal digit (`\p{Nd}`), a space any Unicode space separator (`\p{Zs}`), a numeric character any `\p{N}` character. Not referenced by openapi.yaml and read by no generator: no request or response uses it, and no console validates against it yet (its masking is ADR-0057 decision 3, a later release). The agent's contract tests check that every normalized name that is not a `KeyPattern` matches it (agent/crates/classifiers/tests/identifier_produced.rs). Patterns use Unicode property escapes (the `u` flag) and the subset of the syntax the Rust `regex` crate shares.

anyOf.title: rule 1
anyOf.description: No name, segment or LDAP RDN value made only of 9 or more digits (\p{Nd}), spaces (\p{Zs}), `_`, `+` and `-`.

anyOf.title: rule 2
anyOf.description: No run of 9 or more characters made of digits (\p{Nd}) and separators (`.`, `_`, `+`, `-`, \p{Zs} spaces, \p{Pd} dashes, U+FF0E) that starts and ends with a digit (a phone or card number split across segments: `06.12.34.56.78`, `06_12_34_56_78`).

anyOf.title: rule 3-ipv4
anyOf.description: No IPv4 address as whole segments (`host.10.0.0.1`, `10.0.0.1`, `ou=10.0.0.1`).

anyOf.title: rule 3-mac-dotted
anyOf.description: No dotted MAC address as whole segments: three segments of 4 hexadecimal characters, at least one of which holds a digit (`001a.2b3c.4d5e` is refused, `face.cafe.beef` is not).

anyOf.title: rule 4
anyOf.description: No percent-encoded byte (`%` and two hexadecimal digits) and no `%uXXXX` escape.

anyOf.title: rule 5-run
anyOf.description: No run of more than 6 numeric characters (\p{N}).

anyOf.title: rule 5-total
anyOf.description: No more than 8 numeric characters (\p{N}) in the whole name.
